'''Vala Organa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Duke/Legends|duchess]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Vala convinced [[Muriel Corwin]] to pose as her dead brother, the [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Corwin]], to bolster the morale until a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] uncovered the truth. Vala was willing to make an offer, but the bounty hunter refused and killed her.
{{Endgame}}
